title: X button on the voice remote
slide_intent: Give a physical control a clear center so a user can locate the main navigation action among smaller buttons.
strategic_value: The X placed within the directional control can connect Xfinity’s physical interface with its wider symbol.
demonstration: A close crop of a remote shows an X in a circular center set within a rounded diamond, surrounded by smaller function buttons.
practical_value: Compare the size and enclosure of the central control with neighboring functions when establishing a physical hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Central navigation control
content_islands.spec: Place the X in the circular center of the larger blue rounded-diamond pad.

content_islands.name: Function buttons
content_islands.spec: Retain the smaller buttons above and below so the central control’s prominence is apparent.

content_islands.name: Device lighting
content_islands.spec: Use the visible cyan and green edge lighting to separate the dark remote from the blue field.

ingredient.name: X-centered navigation pad
ingredient.role: Identify the central control while carrying the brand symbol into hardware.
ingredient.application: Place the X at the center of the larger navigation pad and separate surrounding controls with smaller shapes.
ingredient.scope: This remote rendering only; the source gives no dimensional or interaction specification.

reference_purposes.Expression: The white X, blue control and colored edge light carry the identity into a close product view.
reference_purposes.Application: The symbol is applied to the center of a physical remote control.
